title: Big Numbers
text:
Numbers help us count things. Twenty is a small number, but fifty is bigger. My friend Ana is thirty years old. She has forty pencils in her bag.

Our school has sixty students. The library has one hundred books. Ten of the books are about animals. I like the book about cats.

questions.text: How many students does the school have?
What can you infer about the library?
options: It is a large library with many books
It is a very small room with one book
It has no books about animals

questions.text: What can you infer about Ana's bag?
options: It is probably made of paper

vocabulary.definition: people who go to school to learn
a place with many books that people can read or borrow
thin tools for writing or drawing, with a point made of graphite

paragraph_translations: Los números nos ayudan a contar cosas. Veinte es un número pequeño, pero cincuenta es más grande. Mi amiga Ana tiene treinta años. Ella tiene cuarenta lápices en su mochila.
Nuestra escuela tiene sesenta estudiantes. La biblioteca tiene cien libros. Diez de los libros son sobre animales. Me gusta el libro sobre gatos.
